review_description: The team at Fleurieu Solar were an absolute pleasure to deal with and I would highly recommend them.  They provided excellent service, were prompt, courteous and did an excellent job with the installation.

The Myponga Memorial Community Centre investigated Solar options with various installers for a 12kw system.After extensive research and cost comparisons Fleurieu Solar was engaged to supply and install the system to meet the power usage needs within the complex.We found all dealings with proprietor Nathan Bennett to be first class with regards to accuracy, professionalism and quality of work and would have no hesitations in recommending Fleurieu Solar for future work.

Thank you Fleurieu Solar for helping me to save money off my power bills.  After receiving another quote from a much larger company that didnâ€™t provide me with information on the brand of panels or any figures on how much I could be saving I was sceptical on even installing solar.  But Nathan was friendly and professional; he provided a very detailed quote and answered all my questions.  Plus his advice on my power usage was very helpful.  I would recommend Fleurieu Solar to anyone looking to install solar.

Fleurieu Solar were a great company to deal with. Nathan was extremely knowledgeable on solar systems. He was able to answer all our questions and made sure our solar system met the requirements we were after. Service was fantastic and would have no hesitation in recommending Fleurieu Solar for solar system installation.

We couldn't have been happier with Fleurieu Solar-they assessed our electricity bills and recommended the best system for us to reduce our electricity costs. They were informative, honest and reliable. Their follow up service is outstanding with system checks and maintenance where required to make sure the system is working to full capacity.

Ours was not the cheapest solution (and neither was it the dearest) but we are more than pleased with the value. Other friends have already experienced problems with their solar systems; you get what you pay for - and repairs are not cheap.
